svg.title: FIG-18 Target RAM maintenance settlement Selected V / Cache off; timeout retains responsibility
svg.desc: Ordinary provider admission Validate fixed binding, input, deadline, layout and context; Return rejection No retained temporary effects or physical trigger; Assembly entry: preserve caller CPU state Private MSP; MPU CTRL / RNR / RBAR / RASR in r8-r11; C RAM phase publishes private VTOR Prove readback before installing MPU guard; C RAM phase: scan all 16 RASR.EN Save selected guard state; track every selector effect; Install / prove Code-domain MPU guard XN + Strongly-ordered + AP001; CTRL7; DSB / ISB; Before trigger: prove both banks idle Restore / read back every acquired MPU / selector effect; Issue at most one validated physical pulse Eight staged word reads / stores, or erase START; C RAM phase retains guard and workspace Poll both-bank BSY / QW / WBNE with valid TIM2 epoch; Latch TIMEOUT after trigger Do not cancel, clear busy or return; Both banks actually idle Prove target LOCK and required barriers; C RAM phase restores / reads back MPU Retain private VTOR and private MSP; Independent assembly gate: every returning C path Read back idle banks, zero effects, exact saved CR | LOCK Prove MPU against protected r8-r11 captures; Assembly gate restores linker-known g_pfnVectors DSB / ISB; prove exact VTOR readback; Assembly bridge restores exact caller state MSP / PSP / CONTROL / PRIMASK and callee registers; Return settled result to ordinary code IO; else latched TIMEOUT; else SUCCESS; Selector ledger: entry, C phase and assembly gate Set before RNR write; clear after exact restore / readback; Nonreturning RAM terminal Retain unproved responsibility; no hidden reset / watchdog feed; invalid; no acquired effects; admitted and command staged; capture / selector restoration proved; capture or selector restore refused; private VTOR read back; pre-trigger publication refused; supported disabled MPU; no enabled foreign region; pre-trigger refusal after selector effect; guard and final pre-issue deadline proved; guard / deadline refused; rollback and idle proved; rejection result; rollback or idle unproved; pulse may be active; latch errors; any busy bit remains; including permanent busy; absolute deadline expires; continue real polling; epoch lost / exhausted or proof unavailable; all actual busy bits withdrawn; LOCK and time observations proved; LOCK unproved; exact guard withdrawal proved; restoration unproved; independent hardware checks proved; any return condition unproved; exact fixed VTOR read back; VTOR restoration unproved; post-pulse settlement proved; pre-trigger rollback / restoration proved; one embedded ledger, no second owner
